All 2 MAJOR + 4 MINOR from CHECK-1 are individually CLOSED at the bytes, none carried forward. Eight defects survive verification; all eight are MINOR-with-mitigation or INFO, zero MAJOR, zero MEDIUM — the bar is met. Six of the eight share one shape: a receipt that went stale or pointed one line/row/hit next door, the class the register itself convicts at S-19 and E1-1; not one is a wrong conclusion, and every cure is one command.
